project.name: spreadsheet-extension
project.description: Build the Spreadsheet Extension .lex file. Invoked by maven-antrun-plugin from pom.xml; properties are passed in.

target.name: manifest
target.echo: Manifest-Version: 1.0 Built-Date: ${builtDate} version: "${bundleversion}" id: "${id}" artifactId: "${artifactId}" name: "${label}" description: "${description}" lucee-core-version: "${luceeCoreVersion}" release-type: ${releaseType} start-bundles: false maven: "org.apache.poi:poi-ooxml-full:${poi.version},org.apache.poi:poi-ooxml:${poi.version},org.apache.poi:poi:${poi.version},com.github.pjfanning:excel-streaming-reader:${excel.streaming.reader.version}"
